job: Return to the one obvious previous place.
purpose: A link with a left arrow and a label such as "Back to dashboard". The arrow travels a few pixels on hover. Use it when there is one place to return to, not a hierarchy.
useWhen: A detail or a result screen has one parent to return to.
A phone screen needs a way back to its list.

avoidWhen.when: The screen is several levels deep.
The action cancels or dismisses a task in a dialog.
